```yaml
name: Auto-regenerate cargo-vet exemptions

on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - "Cargo.lock"

permissions:
  contents: write
  pull-requests: write

jobs:
  regenerate-exemptions:
    if: github.actor == 'dependabot[bot]' && github.event.pull_request.user.login == 'dependabot[bot]'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Setup Rust
        uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable

      - name: Install cargo-vet
        run: |
          cargo install cargo-vet

      - name: Regenerate exemptions
        run: |
          cargo vet regenerate exemptions

      - name: Check for changes
        id: git-check
        run: |
          if [ -z "$(git status --porcelain)" ]; then
            echo "no-changes=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          else
            echo "no-changes=false" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          fi

      - name: Commit and push changes
        if: steps.git-check.outputs.no-changes == 'false'
        run: |
          git config --local user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config --local user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git add .
          git commit -m "chore: auto-update cargo-vet exemptions"
          git push origin HEAD:${{ github.head_ref }}
```
